title: Deferred import can escape the save path
problem: The deferred import runs before the `try` block. An import failure escapes when Django runs this callback after a transaction commits. This can return an error for a successful TaskRun write.
suggestion: Move the import inside the `try` block so `_start_stamphog_review` contains all callback failures.
cluster_issue: Deferred (in-function) import of the Stamphog facade inside the on_commit callback in receivers.py can fail outside the try block
